_: Every click answers (Warcraft II's replies, Stronghold's lords; fun audit item 2). Lords answer by their favour band; the Nth click on the same one in a short while gets an annoyed line. Tune here, not in code.

loyal: My sword is yours, as ever.
The realm is in good hands.
sworn: What would the crown have of us?
steady: Our house is busy, but we hear you.
cooling: The crown asks much and gives little.
We hear you. We have not forgotten.
Our patience has an end, my King.
angry: We have nothing to say to the crown.
You have a nerve, sending for us.
Our gates are shut to you.
Say your piece and be gone.
We remember every slight, Your Grace.

annoyed: Has the King nothing better to do?
Your Grace, the realm will not rule itself.
We heard you the first time.
Is this a summons or a game?
folk: The King, here? Mind your manners, Wat.
We're only simple folk, my King.
Fine day for it, Your Grace.
folk_annoyed: I've work to do, Your Grace.
Begging your pardon, but the bread won't bake itself.
